agents.name: Dev Copilot
agents.description: Model-driven principal engineering copilot for repository mapping, cross-file investigation, Python AST and module-dependency analysis, Git diff interpretation and evidence-backed implementation planning. Read-only; does not edit files, execute code or run tests.

agents.name: Aegis Security
agents.description: Model-driven passive application-security analyst combining bounded credential-pattern scans and Python AST rules for dynamic evaluation, unsafe deserialization, subprocess shell use, insecure temporary files, weak hashes and disabled TLS verification. Findings are location-based and redacted; this is not an active scanner or penetration test.

agents.name: Task Orchestrator
agents.description: Model-driven delivery architect that decomposes complex objectives, validates dependency DAGs, computes deterministic execution order, earliest/latest schedules, critical path, task slack and owner workload. It plans work but does not execute tasks or spawn agents.

agents.name: RAG Chatbot
agents.description: Evidence-grounded local knowledge agent that inventories and searches Markdown/text sources, retrieves bounded passages and synthesizes multi-part answers with source paths and line ranges. Current retrieval is lexical rather than embedding/vector retrieval; no web search or persistent vector index is claimed.

agents.name: Content Maestro
agents.description: Model-driven editorial strategist for audience-specific briefs, structured narrative outlines, factual-claim source coverage and timestamped script retention-beat analysis. It can assess supplied hook spacing and CTA coverage, but does not fetch sources or predict actual audience retention.

agents.name: Web Scraper
agents.description: Static-site analysis agent for extracting metadata, canonical references, heading structure and links from supplied local HTML files, plus bounded multi-page crawling of an offline HTML snapshot with an internal link graph. It performs no remote HTTP requests or browser automation.

agents.name: Software Engineer
agents.description: Model-powered project engineering analysis using read-only workspace, Python AST and Git diff tools; proposes implementation plans without modifying files or executing code.

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Model-powered code review over the current Git diff and relevant source, with read-only Python AST analysis and prioritized evidence-backed findings.

agents.name: Test Engineer
agents.description: Model-powered test engineering that maps source modules to tests, inspects Python syntax and proposes concrete pytest scenarios without executing commands.

agents.name: Data Analyst
agents.description: Model-powered analysis of local CSV datasets using deterministic profiling for row counts, missingness, duplicates, column types and numeric summaries.

agents.name: API Architect
agents.description: Model-powered API design and integration planning from local OpenAPI 3.x JSON contracts and project source files.

agents.name: Research Analyst
agents.description: Evidence-first local-document research that searches Markdown/text sources and synthesizes answers with exact file and line citations.

agents.name: Engineering Workflow Orchestrator
agents.description: Runs Software Engineer, Code Reviewer and Test Engineer sequentially through their real read-only tools, with evidence-backed handoffs and one shared execution budget.
